_about: Lines flagged in soundweb as needing a REWRITE -- the words are wrong, so every take of them is wrong. Keyed by canonical stem. Written by the Rewrite button's panel, which carries an optional 'note' -- Sam's suggested replacement, entered before the flag is written at all. Clear an entry by unflagging it there, or by hand once the line in voice-lines.json (or card-voice-casting.json) has been rewritten and regenerated.

vo_card_grave_caretaker_solen_attack_2.note: I reap what I am owed.

vo_card_grave_caretaker_solen_death_1.text: Rise, and finish what I started.

vo_card_grave_caretaker_solen_death_2.note: I have longed for this peace.

vo_card_grave_caretaker_solen_play_2.text: Rest easy. I'm still watching over you.

vo_card_neutral_aric_death_2.text: First among many... now among the fallen.

vo_card_neutral_aric_death_3.note: I am dying, but the Resistance cannot.
